Container.Name: ZentProxy
Container.Overview: Lightweight reverse proxy control plane with per-host analytics, trusted-proxy providers, developer API and ZentLoop integration.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, proxy configuration, logs and certificates.

Config.Name: Migration source data
Config.Description: Optional read-only source /data directory for full migration (certificates and Basic Auth material).

Config.Name: Migration source Let's Encrypt
Config.Description: Optional read-only source /etc/letsencrypt directory for full certificate migration.

Config.Name: HTTP3 UDP
Config.Description: Reserved UDP mapping for HTTP/3 support.

Config.Name: WebUI / API
Config.Description: ZentProxy administrator Web UI and API.

Config.Name: Admin e-mail
Config.Description: Initial administrator e-mail. Also used as the default Let's Encrypt account e-mail.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Initial password. Leave empty to generate one on first start; it is printed in the log and temporarily stored in /data/bootstrap-admin.txt until the first successful login.

Config.Name: Raw analytics retention
Config.Description: Days to retain raw request records in SQLite.

Config.Name: Analytics spool max MB
Config.Description: Rotate the processed access-log spool after this size; statistics remain in SQLite.

Config.Name: Provider refresh hours
Config.Description: How often maintained trusted-proxy provider ranges are checked.
